tiers.1: Peer-reviewed primary research or a scholarly review
tiers.2: University, veterinary school, museum, or government research body
tiers.3: Reputable animal welfare or professional veterinary organization
tiers.4: Credible edited journalism or historical reference used only for context

notes: Wikipedia and social posts are never evidence, even when they link to a real study.
A DOI URL is accepted only when the DOI is also recorded in the source record.
News sources may supply context or a named real-life story, never a scientific claim on their own.
